items.question: How is the ritual hand gesture known as the axe seal to be formed?
premises: The fingers are to be closed together.
The fingers are to be extended.
One should form a ritual hand gesture.
This gesture bears the name of the axe.
items.inference: The axe-named gesture is formed by making the fingers closed together and extended.
uncertainties: The exact physical arrangement implied by combining 'closed together' and 'extended' is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One should form the gesture called the axe seal with the fingers closed together and extended.
